{{Quote|One of the most elite commando units in all of the Sith Empire. Five of the Emperor's deadliest agents.|Harron Tavus|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Shadow Fist''' was an elite [[Imperial commando (Sith Empire)|commando]] unit in the reformed [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that saw service against the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] [[Great Galactic War|war]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In this time, they were known to had regularly clashed with [[Havoc Squad]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]]. These elite fighters were extremely skilled combatants to the point that [[Harron Tavus]] remarked that they had been incredibly difficult foes to fight. Members of the Shadow Fist were considered among the deadliest agents of the Sith Emperor.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Tavus along with much of Havoc Squad defecting from the Republic and joined forces with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] after feeling that they had been abandoned by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] over an incident on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]. However, the lone loyalist member of Havoc Squad led a new team with the intention of tracking down the defectors. After losing [[Ryler Dorant|Needles]], Tavus decided to enlist the aid of his former enemies in the Shadow Fist to eliminate the new Havoc Squad leader. At this time, there were five members of the unit who used [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generators]] to ambush their target but were eliminated by the [[Republic trooper]].
